name: Lorraine, Honed Operative's On Enter banishes random memory and draws replacements
notes: Previously abandoned as blocked by 'cross-tool nondeterminism' after an unexplained memory/hand discrepancy. Root cause was misdiagnosed: EngineDeterministicHashMaterial() hashing the full game state is deliberate design (Core/DeterministicRNG.php), not a bug -- two different harnesses reaching the 'same' point via different bootstrap paths were never guaranteed to produce identical RNG streams, and this fixture was re-verified using only the standard pipeline (this script + RunIntegrationTests.php) consistently instead. The REAL mechanism, found by adding temporary debug instrumentation (fully reverted) to Custom/MaterializeLogic.php and Custom/CardDQHandlers.php and confirming with RunIntegrationTests.php: RecollectionPhase() (Custom/GameLogic.php, comment 'Must run BEFORE memory is returned to hand') returns your ENTIRE memory zone to hand at the start of every one of your own turns except turn 1 -- this is core game design, not an engine defect. Turn order is WU -> MAT -> BREC -> REC -> DRAW -> MAIN, so a turn's Materialize phase (where champion level-ups happen) runs BEFORE that turn's own Recollection. A one-time memory seed at pregame setup survives to fund the FIRST level-up (turn 2's Materialize, before turn 2's Recollection has run) but is fully returned to hand by turn 3's Recollection before turn 3's Materialize phase (the second level-up) can spend it -- memory has to be rebuilt during turn 2's Main phase (after turn 2's own Recollection already ran) to still be present when turn 3's Materialize phase starts. Harness Mana (G2XFRE8rFX, 0 reserve cost, 'Put any amount of cards from your hand into your memory', CardDQHandlers.php customDQHandlers['HarnessManaLoop']) is seeded to a known hand slot and used as that refill during turn 2's Main phase, converting 3 hand cards to memory -- enough to pay Honed Operative's 2-memory level-up cost on turn 3 with 1 left over for her own On Enter to actually banish. A second, real bug was found and fixed along the way: her own ability handler (customDQHandlers['LorraineHonedOperativeBanishMemory']) used plain PHP shuffle() instead of the engine's EngineShuffle() wrapper, bypassing deterministic RNG entirely -- fixed directly in that tracked, hand-maintained file (NOT one of the generated/gitignored per-app engine files, contrary to the original abandonment note). Finally: resolving her On Enter's banish decision (turn 3's Materialize-phase champion swap) is the LAST pending decision that turn, so auto-advance continues straight through turn 3's OWN Recollection (returning the freshly-drawn replacement memory card right back to hand) and Draw phase before landing on a stable Main-phase snapshot -- so myMemory's post-ability value is NOT a usable assertion (it's transiently 1, then wiped back to 0 by the same turn's Recollection before any snapshot can capture it). The clean, recollection-proof assertion is myBanish's count, isolated across exactly the banish-response action (3 -> 4), which recollection never touches.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Banish up to three cards at random from your memory. For each card banished this way, draw a card into your memory.
